intro.title: Atlantis Kingdom
intro.text: You discover lost Atlantis! The Sea King appears: 'Our ancient code-powered defenses are failing. Help us!'

coral.title: Coral Code Variables
coral.text: Glowing coral reefs store memories. Dolphin Echo: 'Each coral is a VARIABLE holding sea knowledge. Name them to access wisdom!'

coral_success.title: Coral Illuminated!
coral_success.text: The reef pulses with light! Echo: 'Yes! Variables organize ocean data - temperature, species, currents - all labeled!'

coral_lesson.title: Lost in Translation
coral_lesson.text: You're overwhelmed! Echo: 'Without variable labels, data is chaos. Let me teach you...'

gate.title: Guardian Gate
gate.text: Ancient turtle guards gate: 'Only those who understand IF-ELSE enter. IF you have the pearl, gate opens, ELSE sealed.' You have it!

gate_success.title: Gateway Opened!
gate_success.text: Gate glows and opens! Turtle nods: 'Wise. You evaluated hasPearl equals true and chose correctly!'

gate_lesson.title: Barrier Holds
gate_lesson.text: You bounce off! Turtle: 'Gate checks IF hasPearl is TRUE. You have it, but didn't use the condition!'

palace.title: Palace Loop Current
palace.text: Healing current flows in circles. Seahorse: 'Current LOOPS around 7 pillars to distribute energy. One loop, seven repetitions!'

palace_success.title: Current Restored!
palace_success.text: Energy flows perfectly! Seahorse: 'Beautiful! One loop handles any repetitions. Ancients built Atlantis with loops!'

palace_lesson.title: Energy Wasted
palace_lesson.text: You're exhausted after 3 pillars! Seahorse: 'Loops do the work for you. Watch...'

king.title: Sea King's Functions
king.text: Sea King: 'Defense system calls protectNorth(), South(), East(), West() constantly. Create FUNCTIONS to organize!'

king_success.title: Kingdom Defended!
king_success.text: Atlantis glows with energy! King: 'You mastered functions - foundation of great code! You saved our kingdom!'

king_lesson.title: System Overload
king_lesson.text: Code tangles! Echo: 'Functions keep code organized. Group related commands into named functions!'

finale.title: Guardian of Atlantis
finale.text: Sea King crowns you: 'Variables organize, conditionals decide, loops repeat, functions structure. Atlantis remembers you forever!'

complete.title: Atlantis Saved!
complete.text: Congratulations! You've saved Atlantis and mastered coding fundamentals!
